out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Repeated reports that out of body there was 'no pain' and 'total bliss'.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Archangel Michael (explicitly identified). Also references 'Christ light/Christ consciousness' (not clearly a person encountered).
arrival.other_being_detail: Five great beings in a 'conference room/boardroom'; later 'almost a dozen beings of tremendous light'; later 'five great golden angels' and a female figure formed from one.

environment.environment_other_detail: Elegant boardroom/conference room with long wooden table; 'celestial sphere'; 'inner sanctuary' with seraphim/cherubim-like presences; vast expanse of angels; dark outer-space-like training area; black 'curtain' opening in grass during release.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Beings said he had done more than contracted and could stay; if he returned he would be of 'way greater benefit'. Later framed as being prepared for a 'next phase' and 'advanced lessons' training.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Multiple episodes: severe gout (first), heart attack with flatline in ambulance (second), cardiac arrest during gym workout (third).

person_demographics.location_city: Mount Shasta (mentioned as where he lived at the time).
person_demographics.occupation: Author/spiritual teacher; formerly a nurse (late teens to ~20).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: No tunnel reported. Includes 'advanced lessons/graduate school' training; 'horrific images' practice of non-resistance; 'contract wiped clean/new lifetime'; 'green light' from spirit; communion with Mother Earth and discharge of accumulated energies.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experiences described across multiple episodes; often OBE → encounter with beings/environment → decision/return; some episodes include training sequences before return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple NDEs (five total claimed) with recurring encounters with groups of luminous/angelic beings; repeated 'training' segments in the third experience (3–4 cycles).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Boardroom/conference-room meeting with five beings; explicit 'contract' language ('done more than contracted'; later 'brand-new contract' and prior commitments 'wiped clean'); 'green light' as spirit approval to go to ER; chanting Jewish prayer for the dead without knowing Hebrew (reported by wife); communion with Mother Earth where grass turned to 'black, velvety black' and accumulated energies/faces poured out; 'advanced lessons/graduate school' training including exposure to horrific images to practice non-resistance; detailed perception of angels/seraphim/cherubim-like presences and 'eternal flame of God's Divine Love'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You have done more than what you've contracted for this lifetime.” / “If you go back, you would be of way greater benefit.” / “Fine.” / “I lifted out of my body and went through the roof of the ambulance…” / “sitting right by the eternal flame of God's Divine Love.” / “I'm going to commit myself to living the eternal life.”
